seo.title: Services
seo.seo_title: AI services for small businesses in Quebec
seo.seo_description: Diagnosis, AI server installation on your premises or in Quebec, custom automation and day-to-day operation: Nexora AI's services for small businesses.

blocks.role: Hub des services : promesse et CTA.

translation.headline: From idea to operation. With you.
translation.subheadline: Nexora AI designs, installs, integrates and supports AI systems fitted to your trade. A diagnosis first, then a written estimate, then a first case put into service.

translation.title: Four services, one thread.
translation.intro: From the first conversation to daily operation, the same people follow you and the same control rules apply.

cards.title: The diagnosis.
cards.text: We describe with you the case at hand, your software, your volumes, the deployment mode under consideration and the integrations needed. It leads to a written estimate.

cards.title: AI server installation.
cards.text: On your premises or in our infrastructure in Quebec: sizing, installation, configuration, checking of data flows.

cards.title: Custom automation.
cards.text: Agents and workflows built for your processes, connected to your software, tested on your real cases.

cards.title: Operations.
cards.text: We run the system with you, track what works, adjust the rest; training for your team covers usage and supervision.

translation.title: What makes the estimate vary.
translation.body: There is no public price yet, and we announce no universal timeline. After the diagnosis, we provide a written estimate that states what is included and what is not. Here is what makes it vary.

items.title: The number of cases handled.
items.text: One well-chosen case first; others afterward.

items.title: The volume of documents.
items.text: It weighs on indexing and on storage.

items.title: The deployment mode.
items.text: On your premises or with us: the cost items are not the same.

items.title: The integrations.
items.text: Each piece of software to connect is qualified; some take more work than others.

items.title: The hardware, on your premises.
items.text: It is sized according to the number of users, the volume of documents and the model chosen.

blocks.role: Ce que nous ne faisons pas : limites écrites.

cards.title: That everything can be automated.
cards.text: Not every computing task can be done without constraints. We say so before you commit.

cards.title: Products not yet delivered.
cards.text: Telephony, camera vision and specialized models are not delivered products; they can be the subject of a feasibility study.

cards.title: An announced service level.
cards.text: No availability level or response time is announced today; they are set out in the contract.

items.question: Do we need technical staff?
items.answer: No. We install, run with you and evolve the system. Your team's training covers usage and supervision, not the technical side.

items.question: Who handles updates?
items.answer: We do, as agreed in the contract. Updates are listed among the outbound flows in the diagram we hand over.

items.question: What if we want to stop?
items.answer: You leave with your documents, configurations and workflows: export is provided for in the contract from the start.

items.question: Can we start small?
items.answer: That is the method: one concrete case, put into service and verified, before expanding.

translation.title: Let's start with a diagnosis.
translation.text: Describe your first case. We will tell you what is feasible, in which mode, and what it would take to set it up.
